content: चक्रिन् {%a.%} [चक्रमस्त्यस्य इनि] .²1 Having a wheel, wheeled. .²2 Bearing a discus. .²3 Driving in a carriage. .²4 circular, round. .²5 Indicative (सूचक). --{%m.%} .²1 An epithet of Viṣṇu or Kṛṣṇa, <ls>Śi. 13. 22</ls>; प्रणेमुः पाण्डवा भीष्मं सानुगाः सह चक्रिणा <ls>Bhāg. 1. 9. 4</ls>. .²2 A potter. .²3 An oilman. .²4 An emperor, a universal monarch, absolute ruler. .²5 The governor of a province. .²6 An ass. .²7 The ruddy goose. .²8 An informer. .²9 A snake. .²10 A crow. .²11 A kind of tumbler or juggler.
